$comment: Route-level clean-room partition for the first real Reactive substrate (docs/v2-cold-start-cohort-spike.md §4.4, applied at route granularity because one host serves many independent screens). Declared BEFORE any structural harvest. Prior contact, disclosed: on 2026-09-04 a fresh session rendered the seven `study` routes once and read structural counts only (no accessible names, no text); the `heldOut` and `outOfScope` routes were never fetched. The harvest guard at workshop/substrate-study/application/study-partition.ts refuses any route not listed under `study`.
declaredBy: claude (fresh session, not the agent that trained the classifier)
publisher: OutSystems — public product showcase for the OutSystems UI framework; anonymous; no robots.txt served; no consent banner
rules: C1 — routes are assigned before contact; this file is committed before the first harvest.
C2 — held-out routes never feed canon graduation, matcher proposals, or classifier changes; they are reserved for a designated single-use evaluation.
C3 — a held-out evaluation is single-use per canon fingerprint and per versionToken.
C4 — promotion heldOut → study is allowed once and is irreversible; study → heldOut is forbidden.
C5 — held-out fixtures are authored by a human from screenshots, blind to catalog contents; the agent does not read held-out accessible names.
C6 — a leak is logged, the route is demoted to study, and a replacement held-out route is named; pretending is the only unrecoverable failure.
Harvest posture — read-only; one route per invocation; disclosed User-Agent; no link following; no form submission; no clicks on controls that could create, update, or delete records.
Out-of-scope routes are documentation screens (pattern galleries, release notes, cheat sheets) and screens that require query parameters; they are not app-like and are never fetched by a harness.
